intro.data: Trace each user to their email, that email's host, and the host's domain — three steps, each in a box, each able to fail. The tray holds the three steps and bind machines (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire ONE pipeline. THREE cases keep you honest: Ada is complete; Bo has an email but no host; Cy has no email at all — so the pipeline must reach Ada's domain yet short-circuit to Nothing for Bo and Cy, never inventing anything.
intro.alchemy: Trace each herb to its essence, that essence's salt, and the salt's crystal — three steps, each in a vial, each able to come up empty. The tray holds the steps and decant apparatus (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire ONE line. THREE cases: Sage is complete; Rue has an essence but no salt; Cress has no essence at all — so the line must reach Sage's crystal yet stay empty for Rue and Cress.
intro.spellcraft: Trace each rune to its omen, that omen's sign, and the sign's fate — three steps, each in a charm, each able to fizzle. The tray holds the workings (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire ONE weave. THREE cases: Ash is complete; Bramble has an omen but no sign; Cinder has no omen at all — so the weave must reach Ash's fate yet stay dark for Bramble and Cinder.
intro.abstract: Just x means the value x is present; Nothing means absent; bind runs the next step on a Just but passes Nothing straight through. From the tray bring three Kleisli arrows and wire A through T(B), T(C) to T(D). Three inputs short-circuit at different depths (full, Nothing at step 2, Nothing at step 1); a faithful pipeline passes all three, each impostor fabricates on a short-circuit case — so leave them behind.

goal.data: Bring the faithful machines from the tray and wire one pipeline: Ada → her domain, Bo → Nothing, Cy → Nothing.
goal.alchemy: Bring the faithful apparatus from the tray and wire one line: Sage → its crystal, Rue → empty, Cress → empty.

goal.abstract: Bring the three arrows from the tray and wire A to T(D), passing all three cases with one chain.

afterSuccess.data: One pipeline, three outcomes: Ada reached her domain, while Bo and Cy each short-circuited to Nothing at exactly the step their data ran out — no invented hosts, no invented domains. That's the whole point of a monad: bind threads the 'might be empty' through every step, so failure propagates honestly by construction. Every impostor passed Ada and fabricated on Bo or Cy — which is why the suite tests the failures, not just the happy path. Optional, List, State, and Promise are all monads.
afterSuccess.alchemy: One pipeline, three outcomes: Sage reached its crystal, while Rue and Cress stayed empty exactly where the matter ran out. That's a monad: bind threads 'might be empty' through every step. The impostors passed Sage and fabricated on a failing case.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: One pipeline, three outcomes: Ash reached its fate, while Bramble and Cinder stayed dark exactly where the thread ran out. That's a monad: bind threads 'might fizzle' through every step. The impostors passed Ash and fabricated on a failing case.
afterSuccess.abstract: bind threaded ∅ through the chain, so the composite of Kleisli arrows short-circuited at the right depth for each input. The monad laws make this composition associative and unit-respecting — failure propagates by the laws, tested across all three cases.

reveal.summary: A monad (a functor T with return η and bind/join μ obeying the unit and associativity laws) lets you chain steps that carry an effect — here 'might be empty' — so the effect threads through automatically. Testing several inputs is what proves a pipeline really short-circuits instead of fabricating.
reveal.moreFormal: The monad laws — left/right identity (bind ∘ return = id) and associativity of bind — guarantee a chain of binds means one unambiguous thing, however grouped. Optional, List, State, and Promise are all monads.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: user.flatMap(getEmail).flatMap(getHost).flatMap(getDomain) — one missing link yields None; nothing invented.
